questions.prompt: An extension saves a custom entry holding 200 query rows. What does the model see of it?
options: Nothing, because custom entries are not in the model's context
A message that says the entry exists
questions.explanation: A custom entry is extension state. It is saved in the session but never sent to the model.

questions.prompt: A context edit has a targetId and a replacement. What happens to the old entry?
options: It is deleted from the file
It stays in the file, and the model sees the replacement instead
It is overwritten with the replacement
It is moved to the end of the file
questions.explanation: The edit is itself appended as a new entry. The old entry stays in the log, and the projection shows the replacement.

questions.prompt: Two context edits point at the same target entry. Which one decides what the model sees?
questions.explanation: The latest edit per target wins, so a newer edit can correct an older one.
